description: This file contains unit tests for the X509AuthHandler class, specifically testing the handling of SSL client certificates and error propagation in the context of X.509 certificate-based authentication within the org.eclipse.hono.service.http package.

classes.name: X509AuthHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of X509AuthHandler, particularly handling SSL session and certificate validation failure scenarios.

classes.name: EmptyCertificate
classes.description: A mock implementation of X509Certificate used in tests to simulate certificates containing only subject and issuer information.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and the X509AuthHandler instance before each test execution.

methods.name: testHandleFailsWithStatusCodeFromAuthProvider
methods.description: Tests that when the client certificate validation fails with a ServiceInvocationException, the handler propagates the error with the correct status code (503).
